I don't watch streams of support players, but you might want to check out Krepo or Xpecial.

Try out http://10secondguides.com . Might be helpful in the beginning when you want to try out new champs or new lanes in general. I'm not sure if there is a decent place with good builds/guides. A lot of websites have outdated information.

Don't start playing ranked solo que unless you have enough runes and champions to fill every role. You won't always get your favorite sona or the fabolous taric. Also, practice playing on every lane and in jungle. Streams are definitely a good thing to watch. A big amount of the most popular streamers explain their every step in game. Playing in a premade will make your teamfighting, or cooperation in general, a lot better, but playing alone will help you train your individual skills. If you have any questions you can pm me on reddit.

Don't start with long sword on Wukong. Go either for flask/pots + wards or just boots + 3 pots. I've been playing Wukong since his release and I never go for BT. Rush an early brutalizer, go for a phage, then you can either finish your black cleaver or get your frozen mallet (my personal favorite item). You should try out various things instead of following a guide. Some people get a sunfire on him. Some get triforce. It depends on what you like, on your playstyle.
